assessments.regional_state: The selected regional installation status stores a preparation ticket, a Preparing/Ready/Failed phase and an optional failure. Its field shape can represent mismatched phase/error pairs. The displayed admission constructors pair Ready and Preparing with None and Failed with Some(error); the settle transition changes Preparing to Ready in place without clearing error, so its coherence depends on the incoming Preparing/None invariant. No selected transition demonstrates an invalid pair. Its serialized ticket, phase and error feed the browser consumer. Older installed city, pending candidate and render readiness remain separate observations.
